canonical_project: MERLIN Edged Lisbon AI Campus (Vila Franca de Xira)
notes: 180 MW AI data centre campus in the Parque das Nacoes business district of Vila Franca de Xira (Lisbon district); construction broke ground Oct 2024; five data centers, waterless cooling, 100% solar; potential to scale toward 300 MW per SAPO TEK; Edged reports OCP Ready for hyperscale recognition. Operator release A- for existence/capacity; DCD confirms construction start.
